description: Returns swap quotes for selling one token for another on an EVM chain. By default it returns the Sato Swap quote, whose fee is disclosed in the response, together with a quote that carries no Sato fee, side by side and unranked. Set venue to direct or lifi for the no-Sato-fee quote alone (Sato is not contacted), or 0x with an API key. Quotes only: nothing is signed or sent.

buy_token.description: Token to buy: a 0x address or a symbol.

sell_amount.description: Amount to sell, in base units, as a decimal string.

sell_token.description: Token to sell: a 0x address or a symbol.

slippage_bps.description: Slippage tolerance in basis points. Defaults to 50.

taker.description: Address that would sign the swap.

venue.description: sato (the labelled default, returned together with a quote carrying no Sato fee), direct or lifi (LI.FI only; Sato is not called), 0x (0x only; needs zeroex_api_key).

zeroex_api_key.description: 0x API key, used only when venue is 0x. Never stored or digested.

name: swap_quote

buy_amount.description: Base units the venue quoted, or null.

buy_amount_min.description: Minimum after slippage when the venue states it, or null.

error.description: Why this quote is missing or partial, or null.

fee_disclosure.description: Sato's fee sentence verbatim, or the statement that no Sato fee is added.

route_via.description: The aggregator or tool the venue routed through, or null.

sato_fee_bps.description: Sato's fee in basis points; 0 on every quote not from Sato.

sato_fee_recipient.description: Where the Sato fee goes, or null.

sell_usd.description: USD value of the sell side when the venue returned one, else null.

upstream_fees.description: The venue's own fee fields as returned, or null.

title: Quote a swap
